verdict.rationale: Remote publishes a developer portal for a public REST API. It documents concrete endpoints (`POST /v1/employments`), per-integration tokens, an OAuth-style consent flow for acting on behalf of companies, a sandbox with a test token, and two-way data sync. A live llms.txt for the API docs was also confirmed by probe. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: All employment types are created through the same endpoint — `POST /v1/employments`
push people, contracts, and payroll inputs into Remote, or pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems — sync goes both ways.
You'll get a seeded sandbox company and a working `ra_test_` token by email — no dashboard step needed for this path.
exchange them for access tokens, and act on behalf of the companies that grant you consent.
